instruction: Change the area color to gray, whose RGB = (191, 191, 191) in Grass GIS.

evaluate.key: lambda dump: (lambda good_color: any([param.get('name') == 'fill_color' and good_color(param.get('value', '')) for win in dump.get('windows', []) if win.get('name') == 'boundary_region@PERMANENT' and win.get('_checked') is not False for data in (win.get('_data') or []) if isinstance(data, dict) for param in (data.get('params') or [])]) or any([isinstance(cmd, list) and len(cmd) > 1 and cmd[0] == 'd.vect' and ((isinstance(cmd[1], dict) and str(cmd[1].get('map', '')).startswith('boundary_region') and (good_color(cmd[1].get('fill_color', '')) or good_color(cmd[1].get('fcolor', '')))) or (any([isinstance(part, str) and part.startswith('map=boundary_region') for part in cmd[1:]]) and any([isinstance(part, str) and (part.startswith('fill_color=') or part.startswith('fcolor=')) and good_color(part.split('=', 1)[1]) for part in cmd[1:]]))) for cmd in ([item.get('cmd') for item in dump.get('layers', []) if item.get('name') == 'boundary_region@PERMANENT' and item.get('hidden') is not True] + [data.get('cmd') for win in dump.get('windows', []) if win.get('name') == 'boundary_region@PERMANENT' and win.get('_checked') is not False for data in (win.get('_data') or []) if isinstance(data, dict)])]))(lambda value: str(value).split(':')[:3] == ['191', '191', '191'] and (len(str(value).split(':')) == 3 or str(value).split(':')[3] == '255'))
